precepts.text: Until we measure up unto the full stature of Christ.
precepts.point: If he die, he shall leave a greater name than a thousand men. And look what it says next. And if he live, he shall increase his name. So in other words, if you die, you better than a thousand men. And if you live, your name will continue growing. That's a man that's ever evolving, always getting better, until we measure up unto the full stature of Christ. You may understand that. Read.

note.label: From Milk to Meat: Train All Your Senses

precepts.why:
Sirach describes the man who grows: “If he die, he shall leave a greater name than a thousand: and if he live, he shall increase it.” If you die, you leave a greater name than a thousand men, and if you live, your name keeps growing. That is a man who is ever evolving, always getting better, until we measure up unto the full stature of Christ. That measure is the goal the whole passage is climbing toward.

It comes in steps. First he serves “among great men” and appears “before princes”: studying four chapters a day, occupied in meditation and prophecies, keeping the sayings of the renowned men. Then he repents: he will “pray before the most High, and will open his mouth in prayer, and make supplication for his sins.” Then, “When the great Lord will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding”: when the Lord has seen you making a conscious change, mortifying and disciplining yourself. Before that, the strong meat is not for you. You have to learn the simple things first: no whoremonger shall enter the kingdom of heaven, wear your fringes, remember the Sabbath day to keep it holy, know the twelve tribes.

“In his secrets shall he meditate.” That is the transition from milk to meat. “He shall shew forth that which he hath learned”: out of his mouth comes the wisdom gathered over years of studying, applying, and getting around renowned men. “His name shall live from generation to generation.” That is what you want in your name, still part of the conversation after you leave this earth, for the wisdom God moved in you.

So you have to level up. As a teacher you cannot keep regurgitating the same classes over and over; you have to grow in understanding and application to teach the people. Growing to the full stature of Christ is how a name increases while you live.

They shall rejoice in his commandment, and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word: they do what God tells them to do. note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.why:
This shows how the angels do what the Most High tells them. “There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.” Those are the angels on the left hand of God, and they minister unto God and to us.

“Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance; Teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, serpents, and the sword punishing the wicked to destruction.”

Here is the point: “They shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word.” They do what God tells them to do. They do not have free will to say, let’s go down and sleep with some human women today. That is not what goes on in the heavens.

So when Satan went forth to touch all that Job had, he was doing what God allowed and no more. Even the spirits made for vengeance do not transgress his word.

All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil. Think about today: what do they do with food? GMOs; they put things inside the chicken and the cows to make them larger, and it causes sickness. They monopolize water and bottle it. With fire they create bombs, even nuclear fire. note.label: Religion - The False Prophet

precepts.why:
After Abel was slain, “Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city”. If Cain was the only child left, why would he need to build a city? There were already thousands upon thousands of people on the earth. He named the city after his son Enoch, and down the line came Lamech, who took two wives, the first time multiple wives appear in scripture.

Adah bore Jabal, “the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.” What could be wrong with tents and cattle? Ecclesiasticus answers: “For the good are good things created from the beginning: so evil things for sinners.” From the beginning means from the time of Cain and Abel. “The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.” “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.”

Bring it up to today. What do they do with food? GMOs, and things put inside the chicken and the cows to make them larger, and that causes sickness. They monopolize water and bottle it. With fire they create bombs, even nuclear fire. With iron they make bullets and guns to kill people. The milk today is not the same milk we drank as children. The clothing is made of mixed fabrics. Everything good, the sinful man turns to evil.

That is Cain's city. Jabal dealt in cattle with pricing and unrighteousness. His brother Jubal was “the father of all such as handle the harp and organ”, and it was not holy music: it was music about shake your ass, show me what you going with. Damn. It was songs about murder, drugs, debauchery and adultery, the same wicked songs many love today. Zillah bore Tubal-cain, “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”: that man was making all kinds of weapons. Good things created from the beginning, turned into evil by the seed whose desire was to Satan.

note.label: Trump Is Fulfilling God's Prophecy

precepts.why:
The Lord said, “I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.” How does he bring them? Sirach shows it. “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” Then: “There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.”

God creates spirits for vengeance. The time of destruction is famine, death, plagues and wars, and in that time these spirits pour out their force, and they appease the wrath of the Lord that made them. “Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance”, and “the sword punishing the wicked to destruction.”

So the plagues of 2 Esdras 15 do not come by chance. The Lord is behind the wars you see taking place, Russia and Ukraine, Lebanon, Israel, Palestine, Iran. When you see America bombing Iran and killing all these Palestinians, who is behind that? The Lord is behind that, working it through the spirits he created for vengeance.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
The curse says we would serve our enemies in hunger, thirst, nakedness and want of all things. Why does it target those things specifically? Sirach names the chief things in life: “The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.”

When you target those things, you dehumanize people. You take away the principal things needful for life, for them to be dignified, and those things are robbed from them. That is why they will never let the resources in their so-called backyard be in the control of the people that own them. They must maintain that dominance, the same here and the same in Africa. We see it with Venezuela and Cuba. Our understanding of this scripture is often United States-based, but when you go to these other countries to give the sense, the people are fully aware of the robbing of their resources, and it must be brought to light.

“All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” Because we have not repented, those things are turned over to the ungodly, and we will not reclaim them until the redeemer comes. In the meantime we must repent and keep the laws, statutes and commandments.

That is why “The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.” You think violence has to be a sword, a bomb or a bullet. Defraud people of those principal things and you are a man of blood. Economic violence is still violence. “He that taketh away his neighbour’s living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.” Like the brother in the documentary who works all day and still has no money to eat: their only profit is labour.

Lamentations says the same: “We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.” You see it now in Cuba, in Venezuela, in parts of Africa. Chains don’t have to be chains anymore.
